scope: The 22 user-required groups plus two practical presentation poses. This is a semantic contract, not evidence that an image exists or that all poses belong in every episode.

core.purpose: Stable listening or a scene that already has sufficient motion.
Address the viewer while defining one concept.
Direct attention to a currently relevant left-side subject.
Direct attention to a currently relevant right-side subject.
Refer to the existing upper-left tactical actor or monitor.
Refer to the existing upper-right tactical actor or field.
Name or compare two concepts without implying rivalry.
Represent analysis, interpretation or a human check, without implying doubt where none is narrated.
Confirm a specific just-validated proposition; never infer a final verdict from a machine alert.
A narrated reversal or unusual fact; not constant reaction bait.
Present a connected explanation, then yield to the tactical motion.
Return attention to the viewer for the actual payoff.

referee.purpose: Prepare a meaningful referee intervention or the end sign-off; not every transition.
Referee intervention or brand closure only. The sign-off whistle is not an actual VAR decision signal.
Explain play-on/advantage when the narration names that concept.
Pause or reject an explicit assumption. Use without a card when no caution is being discussed.
A narrated caution/warning concept. Do not use for a device alert, routine confirmation or generic emphasis.
A narrated dismissal or explicit forbidden/wrong distinction, with appropriate context. Do not use as a decorative punctuation mark.
A video-review concept while the monitor is relevant. It must not imply every VAR check requires an on-field review.
Identify the human decision-maker or clearly described decision location; not a machine verdict.
Slow or settle a narrated dispute or distinction. No continuous repeated waving.
The human referee's final authority, after review rather than at automatic detection.

extensions.purpose: Present the left monitor/actor without replacing it with an unrelated prop.
Present the right field/actor without replacing it with an unrelated prop.

current_var_saot_episode.reason: The alert at 27.4 seconds is a technology-to-VAR message, not a disciplinary caution. Neither yellow nor red card adds correct meaning to this script.

referee_pose_candidates.condition: One restrained review-related hold; ensure scene does not falsely depict a mandatory on-field review.
Point to the already-present human referee, not to an invented spot decision.
Keep the approved final sentence and referee authority as the focus.

signoff.comment: The closing icon need not visibly blow a whistle; no lip/face animation is manufactured.

performance_rules: Change only on a narrated concept or an existing action/phase anchor.
Hold a useful pose while the tactical actor moves; do not schedule arbitrary periodic pose changes.
Show exactly one pose per frame; never crossfade different faces or hands.
Use rigid 2–3 frame anticipation/settle only if it preserves caption clearance.
No card, whistle, avatar and headline simultaneously demand equal attention.
Preserve identity, adult proportions, spectacles, hair, beard and charcoal referee outfit across all poses.
Generate left/right as real anatomical variants; never mirror text, face or garment details.
